claims.statement: Test discovery is controlled by JUnit 5 tags defined in TestConstants: `integration_local`, `integration_remote`, and `security`.

McpToolsHelper is a static utility that encapsulates raw MCP protocol interactions: sending initialize, ping, tools/list, and prompts/list JSON-RPC requests to the embedded server, extracting the Mcp-Session-Id header, and parsing SSE-delimited JSON-RPC responses.
McpPingIntegrationTest verifies the MCP ping method returns valid JSON-RPC 2.0 with an object result, using STREAMABLE protocol to avoid keeping an SSE stream open.

McpToolsListIntegrationTest asserts that tools/list returns all 14 expected tools (priorityList, projectList, relationAdd, relationAddParent, relationAllowedValues, relationDelete, relationDeleteParent, relationList, typeList, workPackageCreate, workPackageList, workPackageShow, workPackageUpdate, workPackageUploadAttachment) and validates inputSchema structure including required fields for relationAdd.
McpPromptsIntegrationTest verifies prompts/list returns expected prompts (openproject.workpackage.safe_edit, openproject.project.summary) and that every prompt has a non-blank name and description.

McpSecurityIntegrationTest uses a parameterized OpenProjectTokenValidator stub to verify that MCP methods enforce authentication on initialize, reject unauthenticated requests with 401, and accept valid tokens after a successful initialize session.

McpNoAuthTestSecurityConfig is a @TestConfiguration that overrides the production Spring Security filter chain for MCP endpoints (/mcp, /mcp/**, /sse) with a permit-all rule at order 0, imported by local integration tests to disable authentication.

OpenProjectApiClientIntegrationTest manages a real OpenProject Docker container lifecycle via an ApplicationContextInitializer that runs docker compose up, waits for the /api/v3 health endpoint, generates an admin API key via Rails runner, and tears down the container with docker compose down -v after tests.

OpenProjectApiClientIntegrationTest verifies OpenProjectApiClient behavior including root() authentication, projectList with Demo project, workPackage CRUD with lockVersion, attachment upload, relation add/delete, parent relation management, and error contracts (404 for non-existent IDs, 422 for invalid relations).

PatchMapTest unit tests verify PatchMap.of() filters null values when Nullable.DROP_NULL_VALUES is used, preserves them when Nullable.ALLOW_NULL_VALUES is used, handles empty arguments, throws IllegalArgumentException for odd argument counts, throws ClassCastException for non-string keys, and correctly stores mixed types.

All local MCP integration tests share a common architecture: @SpringBootTest with RANDOM_PORT, @Import of McpNoAuthTestSecurityConfig, @Tag(TAG_INTEGRATION_TEST_LOCAL), @TestInstance(PER_CLASS), and @LocalServerPort.
application-test.properties configures the Docker container settings: image tag (17.7.2), port (18088), shutdown behavior (false), and disables header-based URL override.
